description: Search INSPIRE-HEP papers with INSPIRE query syntax or free text, filtered by document type, subject, and year, sorted by relevance, recency, or citations. Returns one page of papers with recid, title, first author, date, citation counts, arXiv ID, DOI, publication, and an abstract snippet; pass a recid to cern_inspire_get_paper for the full record or to cern_inspire_export_citations ("recid:N") for BibTeX. INSPIRE never rejects malformed syntax: an unparsed operator widens or empties the match, so a very broad or empty result usually means the query needs fixing (cern_inspire_list_reference topic search_syntax). Only the first 10,000 results of a query are reachable.

document_types.description: Restrict to INSPIRE document types (up to 4). Multiple values must ALL hold (published + review = published reviews), not either. Values: article, published, conference paper, thesis, review, note, proceedings, lectures, book chapter, book, introductory, activity report, report.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. page × size may not exceed 10,000.

query.description: INSPIRE query syntax or free text. Common operators: "a Jane.Doe.1" or "a Doe, J" (author), "t higgs boson" (title words), "cn atlas" or "collaboration:atlas" (collaboration), "date > 2015", "topcite 500+" (cited 500+ times), "refersto:recid:451647" (papers citing a record), "citedby:recid:451647" (its references), "j Phys.Rev.Lett." (journal), "eprint 1207.7214"; combine with and/or/not. Bare words search all fields. INSPIRE does not reject malformed syntax; see cern_inspire_list_reference topic search_syntax for the rest.

sort.description: Result order: relevance (default), mostrecent, or mostcited.

subjects.description: Restrict to INSPIRE subject categories (up to 4). Multiple values must ALL hold, not either. Values: Astrophysics, Phenomenology-HEP, Theory-HEP, Quantum Physics, Unknown, Gravitation and Cosmology, Experiment-HEP, Theory-Nucl, Accelerators, Instrumentation, General Physics, Experiment-Nucl, Math and Math Physics, Condensed Matter, Computing, Lattice, Other, Data Analysis and Statistics.

year_from.description: Earliest year to include (1900–2100, inclusive), matched on the earliest date INSPIRE records for the paper. Omit for no lower bound.

year_to.description: Latest year to include (1900–2100, inclusive), matched on the earliest date INSPIRE records for the paper. Omit for no upper bound.

name: cern_inspire_search_literature

appliedFilters.description: Sort and filters applied, e.g. "sort=mostcited; years=2012–2015", or "none".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `beyond_result_window`: page × size exceeds the 10,000 results INSPIRE serves for one query. `invalid_year_range`: year_from is later than year_to. `invalid_query`: INSPIRE answered 400 to a parameter value it refuses. `inspire_rate_limited`: INSPIRE returned 429 after the pacer and retries. `pacer_shed`: The server's outbound INSPIRE queue could not start the request within the call's remaining budget. `upstream_unreadable`: The INSPIRE body exceeded the byte ceiling, was HTML where JSON was expected, or was invalid JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when INSPIRE has a further page of results.

nextPage.description: The page number to request next, when one exists within the 10,000-result window.

notice.description: Guidance on an empty, very broad, or paged result.

papers.description: The papers on this page, in the requested order.

abstractSnippet.description: Start of the abstract as text (arXiv-sourced when available; publisher markup converted, LaTeX left as published), up to 300 characters at a word boundary.

abstractTruncated.description: True when the abstract continues past the snippet; cern_inspire_get_paper has it in full.

arxivId.description: arXiv identifier, when the paper has one.

authorCount.description: Number of authors, when INSPIRE indexes the count.

citationCount.description: Citations INSPIRE counts for the paper.

citationCountWithoutSelf.description: Citations excluding self-citations, when INSPIRE reports it.

collaborations.description: Collaborations credited on the paper; empty for most non-collaboration papers.

date.description: Earliest date INSPIRE records for the paper: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.

doi.description: First DOI, when the paper has one.

firstAuthor.description: First author, when INSPIRE indexes one.

recid.description: INSPIRE author record ID, when linked; pass as query to cern_inspire_search_authors for the profile.

publication.description: First publication reference: "Journal Vol (Year) pages" or its free-text form.

recid.description: INSPIRE literature record ID; pass to cern_inspire_get_paper.

title.description: Title as text: publisher HTML, JATS, and MathML converted (scripts as _x or ^{xy}), LaTeX left as published.

shown.description: Number of papers on this page.

totalCount.description: Total literature records the query matched.

truncated.description: True when more results exist beyond this page.

title: Search INSPIRE literature
